test.fill_query: INSERT INTO strings_0_15 SELECT substring(hex(cityHash64(number)), 1, number % 16) FROM numbers(20000000)
INSERT INTO strings_16_64 SELECT substring(repeat(hex(cityHash64(number)), 4), 1, 16 + number % 49) FROM numbers(4000000)
INSERT INTO strings_0_300 SELECT substring(repeat(hex(cityHash64(number)), 19), 1, number % 301) FROM numbers(1000000)
INSERT INTO strings_1000_2000 SELECT substring(repeat(hex(cityHash64(number)), 125), 1, 1000 + number % 1001) FROM numbers(100000)
INSERT INTO fixed_strings_16 SELECT toFixedString(hex(cityHash64(number)), 16) FROM numbers(5000000)
INSERT INTO ipv6s SELECT CAST(toUInt128(cityHash64(number)) * 18446744073709551557 + number AS IPv6) FROM numbers(5000000)
